archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Coffee shop, warm wood, roasted tones, cream)

entry_surfaces./t/:table: Scenic cafe background with dark roast overlay, oval brand emblem header, rounded brown TABLE # badge top-right, 3x3 rounded menu tile grid with steppers, sticky bottom order action bar
entry_surfaces./orders/review: Warm paper modal sheet showing itemized summary, quantity stepper, customer nickname field, payment method selector (Cash / GCash / Card), confirm order action
entry_surfaces./orders/payment: Payment instructional view with GCash QR scan preview & details, Card entry form, or Cash instructions
entry_surfaces./orders/success: Warm thank-you voucher card with live order status badge, printable receipt button, bill out prompt
entry_surfaces./cashier: Split screen terminal — live table order queue with badge count left, active order breakdown + cashier payment confirmation + receipt print right
entry_surfaces./admin/login: Warm coffee shop branded split login — terms & conditions modal acceptance mandatory before sign-in
entry_surfaces./admin: Management dashboard with tabs for Products CRUD (image URL/upload), Categories, Live Orders & Sales Analytics, 40-table QR generator with bulk printable layout, Backup & Restore JSON, Store Settings

customer_menu.header: Oval logo with mountain/coffee motif, tagline 'STAY FOR A MOMENT. CRAFTED FOR LIFE', prominent Table # badge with table switcher for testing
customer_menu.category_pills: Horizontal scrollable rounded brown pills (All, Coffee, Non-Coffee, Pastries, Meals, Add-ons)
customer_menu.product_grid: 3-column responsive grid on phone/tablet, rounded card tiles (rounded-2xl/3xl), product photo, name, Philippine Peso price (e.g. ₱140.00), quantity decrement/increment pill
customer_menu.bottom_bar: Sticky bottom bar with Total items & amount, View Orders button, Quick Done button

cashier_terminal.table_cards: Visual grid of tables (1-40) with color status: Available (green/cream), Pending Payment (amber), Paid/Served (brown)
cashier_terminal.order_action: Mark as Paid (Cash/GCash/Card verified), Print Official Receipt, Cancel/Refund

admin_dashboard.terms_and_conditions: Configurable T&C text in settings, modal gate on login requiring checkbox consent
admin_dashboard.product_manager: Create/edit/delete product with custom image upload or direct image URL (Imgur/Unsplash/CDN), price, category, availability toggle
admin_dashboard.qr_generator: Generate high-resolution printable QR codes for tables 1 to 40 directly linking to `/t/{number}`
admin_dashboard.sales_reports: Daily sales summary, top selling items, payment method breakdown, Excel (.xlsx) export button
admin_dashboard.cloud_backup: One-click JSON export of database & settings, JSON file restore upload

image_urls.description: Warm mountain cafe background photo with coffee latte art

accessibility.no_emoji_rule: Strictly no emojis throughout the UI as requested. Use Lucide SVG icons exclusively (e.g. Coffee, Utensils, QrCode, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck, Printer, Download, Plus, Minus, CreditCard, Wallet, Banknote).
accessibility.locale_conventions: Currency formatted with Philippine Peso symbol '₱' (e.g. ₱120.00), standard Philippine mobile format (09XX-XXX-XXXX) for GCash payment references.

instructions_to_main_agent: Honor the original sample UI design: warm rounded brown theme (#8C4A27, #6F3E22, #FBF7F0), rounded brown badge for TABLE #, 3-column rounded product tiles, quantity steppers, and pill-shaped action buttons.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the system; use clean Lucide-react icons instead.
Implement real QR code routing: scanning QR routes to `/t/:table` (e.g. `/t/1` to `/t/40`), auto-filling the table number badge.
Include Cashier Terminal (`/cashier`) with real-time order status, payment verification (Cash/GCash/Card), and printable receipt dialog.

Include Admin Dashboard (`/admin`) with login requiring Terms & Conditions modal agreement, full Product CRUD (custom image upload + URL input including Imgur), Category manager, Store Settings (logo, background image, shop name, tagline, GCash QR image), QR code generator for 40 tables with bulk print view, and JSON export/import backup.
Ensure all testable elements contain explicit `data-testid` attributes.
